title: Bhutan Second Nationally Determined Contribution
methodology: Government NDC describing national climate context, institutions, and planned mitigation and adaptation actions.
limitations: Policy submission; planned actions are not evaluated outcomes, and the inspected passages do not quantify local hazard exposure.

title: Assessment of Climate-Induced Loss and Damage in Bhutan
temporal_coverage: Assessment published in 2026; includes a documented October 2025 extreme-weather event.
methodology: Review of secondary documents, key-informant group interviews, stakeholder workshop, and field visits.
limitations: The report notes limited primary datasets and dispersed institutional knowledge; the inspected 2025 event passage reports impacts but does not attribute the event to climate change.

title: Adaptation, Climate Resilience, and Diversification Key to Creating Jobs, Accelerating Growth in Bhutan
temporal_coverage: World Bank publication page dated 2025; reports modeled risks through 2050.
methodology: Official World Bank release summarizing findings and recommendations from its Bhutan Country Climate and Development Report.
limitations: The press-release summary does not provide underlying model specifications; the qualitative hotter-and-drier scenario is not assigned a named pathway.

title: Climate Change Vulnerability Analyses and Mapping for National Adaptation Plan Formulation Process in Bhutan
organization: Royal Government of Bhutan and United Nations Development Programme Bhutan
temporal_coverage: Dzongkhag indicators mainly from 2005-2017 and hazard records from 2010-2018; future risk modeled at five-year intervals to 2050.
methodology: Dzongkhag indices combine government hazard/socioeconomic indicators and stakeholder input.
limitations: Older sparse local data limit temporal/causal precision; projections exclude wildcard events.

title: Kingdom of Bhutan, First National Adaptation Plan 2023
organization: Department of Environment and Climate Change, Ministry of Energy and Natural Resources, Royal Government of Bhutan
temporal_coverage: National adaptation priorities and implementation needs for the medium and long term; document published in 2023.
methodology: The NAP synthesizes four sectoral risk assessments and national and regional stakeholder consultations.
limitations: Adaptation priorities are policy commitments, not verified nationwide service outcomes.

title: Mid Term Review of Advancing Climate Resilience of the Water Sector in Bhutan (ACREWAS)
organization: United Nations Development Programme and Royal Government of Bhutan, Ministry of Infrastructure and Transport
temporal_coverage: Midterm review submitted in February 2026 for a project running from September 2023 to September 2028.
methodology: Non-experimental review used documents, interviews, focus groups and observations.
limitations: Midterm project evidence; some water-access and watershed outcomes were not yet delivered.
